item.title: Duke and Princeton Study Finds Small Parallel Agent Teams Outperform Large Ones
item.description:
A new Duke and Princeton paper finds that, at equal compute, splitting agents into multiple small parallel teams and keeping the best team's result beats both solo-agent best-of-N and one giant team. With a budget of 100 agents, 10 teams of 10 agents running in parallel and selecting the best team outperformed 100 solo agents and a single 100-agent team. The authors recommend splitting budgets into small note-sharing teams and keeping the best answer when a verifier can score results.

原文标题：杜克与普林斯顿发现小团队并行智能体更优

Why it matters：该研究为多智能体系统的组织架构与算力分配提供了可操作的实证结论，对智能体工程实践有直接指导价值。

item.title: All Seven Anthropic Co-Founders to Cash Out About $250M Each in IPO
item.description:
Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals that each of its seven co-founders will sell 3,378,378 shares, netting roughly $250 million apiece at the midpoint of the $70-$78 IPO range. The offering implies a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, with board member Reed Hastings signaling intent to buy $300 million in shares.

item.title: ByteAsk Open-Sources C/C++ Coding Agent Cutting Fix Costs by 68%
item.description:
ByteAsk launched an open-source C/C++ coding agent whose upfront context engine locates the fix site before the model reads code, cutting tokens per run from 1,795K to 395K (about 78%) and cost by 68.1% while fixing the same number of bugs. It also flags sibling sites needing the same edit and validates patches only against covering tests, saving roughly 80% on obscure projects and hard issues.

原文标题：ByteAsk 开源 C/C++ 智能体 降低 68% 修复成本

Why it matters：以真实 token 与成本数据展示智能体上下文工程对编码成本的实质压缩，且开源可复现。

item.description:

It also launched Interactive Connectors that let partners like Adobe, Atlassian and Salesforce embed apps inside Claude, with Claude Meetings coming soon and enterprise-grade audit logs, isolated VMs and a compliance API.

item.title: Hedra Launches Model Factory to Open RSI Loops to Industry
item.description:
Hedra Labs unveiled Model Factory, an autonomous inference and training platform for real-world models. Customers supply machine sensor data and a simulator, while Hedra provides GPUs, AI agents that run training experiments, and researchers to steer them, delivering a model tuned to their own hardware with a post-deployment loop of data collection and online evals. The offering opens the recursive self-improvement loop previously confined to frontier labs to robotics, manufacturing, biology and defense teams.

原文标题：Hedra 推出模型工厂 把 RSI 循环开放给实体产业

item.title: Reasoning as Pathfinding Through Token Space
item.description:
Alex Wang frames reasoning as pathfinding in token space, where each sample is an attempt to find a path from the starting context to a correct answer. This lens explains a puzzle: RL-trained models write longer chains and get more accurate, yet forcing a single chain to run longer at inference helps only briefly before plateauing or degrading. The framework separates the contributions of chain length versus search breadth.

原文标题：推理的本质是在词元空间中寻找路径

Why it matters：对推理机制给出可操作的概念框架，直接回应“更长思维链为何不总是更好”这一核心疑问。

item.title: Oura Acquires AI-Native Primary Care Startup Counsel Health for $625M
item.description:
Smart ring maker Oura announced it will acquire AI-native primary care company Counsel Health for $625 million, folding chat-based medical AI plus licensed physician access into the Oura app and expanding into preventative, acute, and chronic care. The deal follows Oura's indefinite postponement of its up-to-$2.2B IPO, signaling a strategy to build a closed-loop health service and fend off rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman.

Why it matters：大额并购叠加 AI 医疗落地与 IPO 推迟，是硬件厂商向 AI 健康服务转型的标志性产业事件。

item.title: Amazon Debuts Indoor Security Drone That Flies to Alarms
item.description:
Amazon has introduced a self-flying indoor security drone and a ground rover for its Ring ecosystem, both dispatched automatically to preset waypoints when an alarm trips so video may already be streaming before the user opens the alert. The drone rests in its dock with the camera off, records only during flights, uses deliberately loud propellers as a deterrent, and ships with Ring's strongest default encryption.

item.title: Anthropic Launches IPO Seeking Up to $64.4 Billion

item.title: Mozilla Measures Browser Fingerprintability Across 25 Million Firefox Users
item.description:
Mozilla, with the University of Toronto and UC San Diego, ran a large-scale browser fingerprinting study across nearly 25 million Firefox release users to quantify real-world identifiability and isolate which characteristics make users unique. The findings directly shaped the fingerprinting protections shipped in Firefox 143, and the team released the paper, full appendix data, privacy-preserving aggregate datasets, analysis code, and an interactive self-test tool.

原文标题：Mozilla 用 2500 万用户实测浏览器指纹可识别性

Why it matters：这是迄今规模最大的真实用户指纹可识别性实测之一，且成果已落地为浏览器隐私防护并开放数据与代码，对隐私工程与浏览器生态具有直接参考价值。

item.title: PSI Uses AI to Crack 18-Year-Old Quantum Computing Conjecture
item.description:
Startup lab Physical Superintelligence (PSI) used early access to Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model to solve the 18-year-old Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing, and is now trying to build a business around AI-driven scientific discovery. The proof was autoformalized in Lean and reviewed by top researchers, marking a landmark case of AI directly producing frontier mathematical results.

原文标题：PSI 用 AI 攻克 18 年量子计算猜想

Why it matters：这是 AI 直接产出前沿数学证明并尝试商业化的标志性事件，对关注 AI for Science 的读者具有高参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Unveils GR00T 2 to Learn Robot Skills from Human Video
item.description:
Nvidia has introduced GR00T 2, a robotics foundation model that departs from directly mapping camera images and language commands to motor actions. Instead, the model watches humans in video and internally imagines itself performing the motion as a robot before producing control signals, aiming to sharply reduce costly and slow teleoperation data collection.

item.title: Anthropic Kicks Off IPO Roadshow at Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation

item.title: Google DeepMind Launches MKA Benchmark for Multimodal Knowledge Agents
item.description:
Google DeepMind, in partnership with Artificial Analysis, launched the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) evaluation, a benchmark of 200 private real-world visual tasks spanning 10 industries. Agents must interpret dense visual files such as architectural drawings, engineering schematics and clinical scans, then produce deliverables including slide decks, spreadsheets and reports. Scoring uses expert rubrics split into Climb and Regression criteria, averaging about 70 weighted items per task, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 leading in several domains.

原文标题：Google DeepMind 发布 MKA 多模态知识智能体基准

Why it matters：这是面向真实视觉知识工作的智能体评测新基准，任务设计与评分方法具备实质参考价值。

item.title: MBZUAI Releases PAN 2 Open World Model for Simulative Reasoning
item.description:
MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2, an open foundation world model for physical intelligence built around simulative reasoning that lets agents play out outcomes before acting. It splits reasoning into two tracks: an LLM determines what happens, when, and how the camera moves and writes it as text, while a 29B diffusion model trained from scratch renders that text into visuals. Ablating the LLM collapses multi-step performance to 8.7% correct steps with no completed plans, whereas the combined system reaches 75.1% correct steps and 34.0% fully completed plans.

原文标题：MBZUAI 开源 PAN 2 世界模型 支持仿真推理

Why it matters：开源世界模型叠加 LLM 与扩散双路推理，并给出清晰的消融数据，对具身智能与智能体规划方向有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Carbon for Multi-Step Coding and Research

Google also previewed the /swarm feature in Antigravity, which turns a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents. Arriving amid rapid rival releases, the launch already feels late in the current model cycle.

item.title: OpenAI Study Maps How AI Is Reshaping Freelance Work
item.description:
OpenAI's Economic Research Team, in research with Upwork, finds that AI is reshaping demand in the freelance market: traditional service categories are losing share, while AI-related projects bundle multiple capabilities and command larger budgets and more hours. Because freelance contracts are short and requirements shift quickly, the market can signal AI-driven structural change earlier than economy-wide employment data.

item.title: 伯克利研究揭示模型路由降本 25 倍
item.description:
加州大学伯克利分校等机构发布大规模模型路由研究，在 25 个基准、452 个候选模型与策略上跑了 374,401 次评分实验。结论是路由器的核心价值在于把任务导向更便宜的模型，平均每单位成本的质量提升达 8.82 倍，质量损失不到 0.5 分；编程任务中路由达到始终调用 Opus 4.6 的 25.5 倍成本效率，仅损失 0.44 分。但学习型路由器相对最佳单模型的真实增益仅 0.3 分，远低于理论上限 5.4 分。

Why it matters：首个跨文本问答到机器人控制的统一路由评测，给出可复用的成本效率量化结论。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100
